text_block_list.text: Several weeks had passed since the disaster struck.

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
............
I donated, and I volunteered, but...

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
...
What I can accomplish on my own
is pretty negligible anyway.

Even in places far removed from the disaster-stricken areas,
a lingering heaviness hung in the air,
and time simply slipped by.
And so, one day.

Far across the vast sea,
in a foreign land eight thousand kilometers away—

Just like
a ray of light piercing through the dark clouds—
A miracle had occurred.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
To Japan—bring hope!!
DAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHH!!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
『It's Victoire Pisa!
Victoire Pisa wins it!』

In a race contending for the world's best,
it was the first Dubai GI victory ever claimed by a Japanese Umamusume.

Victoire Pisa and Transcend's
one-two finish
erupted into an explosive roar from the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
“A victory by Victoire Pisa that delivers courage and hope to all of Japan!
Stand tall, Japan! Keep fighting, Japan!”

Transcending borders and races, the sight of everyone putting their arms
around each other's shoulders, celebrating the Japanese Umamusume's triumphant feat—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Reach them... reach Japan...!

Above all, the sight of her seizing
an unprecedented victory just now was—

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"'—Your message!
We have received it loud and clear, all the way from Dubai!'"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Girls
text_block_list.text: YESSSS!!!
It reached Japan as an unmistakable beam of light.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Insane, insane, SO insane!
I'm so glad I watched it live!!

text_block_list.name: Introverted Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Pisa-san... *sniff*, *hic*!
I just saw something so breathtaking...!

text_block_list.name: Introverted Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Rose-san, thank you so much
for hosting the viewing event...!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...No, it is fine.
What I did was hardly—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(What you saw, what you felt,
and why you ran in Dubai—
it is not difficult to imagine.)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I want to create a circle across the sea.
Just as we did in Japan, I want to connect heart to heart.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: And so, I wish to kindle hope.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (You have... accomplished it.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(All on her own, she created light.
Connecting hearts, bringing forth hope—)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Across an endless distance,
it has reached all the way here—!)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Pisa, you are truly...!
Haha! What a magnificent Umamusume you are!

As dawn broke, news of Victoire Pisa's monumental feat
spread quietly, yet unmistakably, across all of Japan.

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan
text_block_list.text: ...Whoa, seriously?! ...Haha!

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan
text_block_list.text:
Pisa's unreal.
Driven by nothing more than that sheer desire to do it for Japan...

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan
text_block_list.text:
...I'll do my best too.
Even if it feels insignificant, I'm going to give it my all.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: “Pisa.”

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing the light you kindled,
I learned what 'hope' truly means."

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"The more ablaze hope burns,
the deeper it takes root in the hearts of the people."

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"You granted everyone the power
to illuminate the darkness with their own hands."

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"I was struck with genuine awe.
My truest congratulations on this triumph."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Rose-san...
I was only running with reckless abandon—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: And yet... I want to connect our hearts and bring hope. I don't want anyone to be left alone.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: If these feelings of mine could give rise to something meaningful, nothing could bring me greater joy.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(I am proud from the bottom of my heart
that a horse girl such as you is my friend, and my rival.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (... Above all, the way she created light on her own, bringing hope to everyone—)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (There were even moments that called the Wise King Moss to mind.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: In her, I caught a glimpse of the king I ought to aspire to be.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps that is why.
My heart is blazing now more than ever.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The Rose Kingdom needs a sovereign
who can bring it hope.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
A king is needed who possesses overwhelming might,
and who can cut through adversity with their own strength alone.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: A "Wise King Moss"—is what is required.
